version.changelog:
This release expands the skill from lean/over-engineering review to a full quality review including bugs, tests, security, scale, and performance.

- Broadens scope to review for bugs, security, scalability, missing tests, and slowness, while still flagging unnecessary code.
- Adds detailed review process: read diff, follow code flows, check real-world use and expected load.
- Outputs findings in clear groups (Must fix, Should fix, Nice to have), with concrete problems and fixes for each.
- Makes reporting style simple and actionable, with clear explanations and numbering across all findings.
- Updates boundaries: no style/taste issues, only real technical or operational problems.
- Removes previous card/summary file (skill-card.md); now SKILL.md gives full details.

llm.summary: This is a code-review guidance skill that tells the agent to inspect requested code and report findings without changing files.

dimensions.detail: Reading repository files, diffs, tests, and documentation is proportionate for a code-review skill; PR link handling is user-directed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single Markdown SKILL.md file with no executable scripts, dependencies, remote payload retrieval, or install-time commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to user-requested review work and explicitly say the skill lists findings and changes no code.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, credential handling, memory writes, tool replacement, background workers, or system hooks are present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is diff/code quality review, and the artifact’s instructions align with that purpose: read the relevant diff, callers, tests, README, and report bugs, risks, scale issues, missing tests, speed issues, and removable code.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should expect this skill to read code and related repository context when asked to review a change, then produce a findings report. It does not request mutation authority or install executable components, but users should still review any generated findings before acting on them.
